effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Selects 1 enemy up to 14m away. Attacks 8 enemies in a 4m radius around the target, from a distance of 9m, dealing 49 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 4s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK).

bio: Captain of the Ghostguard Rangers, Shibami and her lethal scouts are the first line of defense for the Cambion lands – but Shibami believes the best defense is a good offense. If the Demons aren’t coming to her, she’ll go to them.
